name: M'ONDUNIQ Dragon Blood brightening and anti-wrinkle serum
shortDescription: High-potency 25 ml concentrate with Croton lechleri (Dragon Blood) resin extract, red algae, hyaluronic acid and D-panthenol – for pigment correction and regeneration.
description:
M'ONDUNIQ Dragon Blood Intensive Brightening and Anti-Wrinkle Serum is a high-potency professional concentrate developed to address pigmentation irregularities, photoageing and dehydration and to support the skin's regenerative processes. Its formula combines synergistic ingredients that not only hydrate the skin but also support its natural repair processes, antioxidant protection and more even appearance. In cosmetic treatments it is particularly important that the skin receives not only hydration but also biologically active ingredients that contribute to optimal cell function and the restoration of the skin's barrier function. The Dragon Blood serum embodies exactly this comprehensive approach.

Croton lechleri, commonly known as Dragon Blood, is one of the best-known Amazonian plant extracts, used in modern aesthetic cosmetics for its regenerating properties. The plant's red resin is extremely rich in polyphenols, antioxidant compounds and natural bioactive molecules. It is particularly valuable in professional cosmetic treatments because it supports the skin's natural regenerative processes, helps restore the comfort of damaged skin, provides antioxidant protection against oxidative stress caused by free radicals, contributes to a firmer, more even skin appearance and is an excellent complement to skin-renewing treatments. This is why Dragon Blood extract is widely used around the world after mesotherapy, microneedling, laser, radiofrequency and other regeneration-focused treatments, when the skin needs intensive support.

The formation of pigmentation spots is a complex process involving inflammation, UV radiation, oxidative stress and increased melanin production. The Dragon Blood serum supports brightening treatments from several angles: it provides antioxidant protection, helps the skin's natural regeneration, supports a more even skin tone, delivers intensive hydration that is essential for healthy pigmentation processes, and combines excellently with professional brightening protocols. Hydrated skin with a proper barrier function regenerates faster and shows a more even surface, so the results of pigment-correction treatments can also be more aesthetic.

In professional cosmetics it is rarely enough to treat a single problem. Most clients present with dehydration, pigmentation, post-inflammatory discolouration, a dull complexion, reduced collagen production, first wrinkles and skin ageing caused by oxidative stress all at once. The advantage of the Dragon Blood serum is that a single product supports several interrelated skin concerns, so it fits perfectly into complex treatment protocols. It does not just hydrate, it also regenerates, provides antioxidant protection, supports the skin barrier, enhances skin comfort, improves overall skin quality and promotes faster recovery after treatments. This is what makes it a truly valuable professional active-ingredient concentrate.

Recommended skin types: hyperpigmented skin, dull, lifeless skin, photoaged skin, mature skin, dehydrated skin, more sensitive skin in need of regeneration, and skin exposed to environmental stress. The Dragon Blood serum is ideal for microneedle mesotherapy, nano-mesotherapy treatments, after hydrodermabrasion, oxygen infusion treatments, ultrasonic active-ingredient delivery, electroporation, as a complement to radiofrequency treatments, in cold plasma skin regeneration protocols, in skin-renewal courses, as part of pigmentation-spot brightening programmes and in anti-ageing treatments.

Directions: apply an appropriate amount of serum to cleansed skin and work it in with gentle massaging movements, or apply it with the professional active-ingredient delivery technology of your choice. As part of a complex treatment protocol, it can be used on its own or combined with other professional M'ONDUNIQ actives. For home use, a broad-spectrum sunscreen is always recommended in the daytime routine. Size: 25 ml.

functionCards.name: Croton lechleri (Dragon Blood) resin extract
functionCards.description: The special resin of this Amazonian plant is extremely rich in antioxidant components. It supports the skin's natural regeneration, helps reduce the effects of external environmental stressors and contributes to a healthier, more balanced complexion.

functionCards.name: Palmaria Palmata red algae extract
functionCards.description: Red algae is an ingredient rich in minerals, amino acids and antioxidants. It supports optimal cell function, promotes skin vitality and contributes to a more radiant, fresher appearance. It is particularly valuable in professional treatments because it supports the skin's natural renewal processes.

functionCards.name: Hyaluronic acid (Sodium Hyaluronate)
functionCards.description: Hyaluronic acid is one of the best-known hydrating molecules, capable of binding up to a thousand times its own weight in water. Benefits: intensive hydration, a plumper complexion, optical reduction of fine lines, increased elasticity, healthier barrier function. Proper hydration is the foundation of every professional anti-ageing treatment.

functionCards.name: D-Panthenol (provitamin B5)
functionCards.description: Panthenol is an active ingredient known for its soothing, hydrating and regenerating properties. It helps reduce irritation, support skin regeneration, improve comfort and strengthen the skin's protective barrier. It plays a particularly important role in skin recovery after treatments.
